records.name: Amity University
records.description: Amity University Noida is one of India's largest and most recognized private universities, offering programs across engineering, management, law, medicine, design, and liberal arts. It has campuses across India and abroad, strong international collaborations, and is known for its well-developed infrastructure and placement support. Amity is accredited 'A+' by NAAC and is a preferred choice for students seeking a broad range of professional programs in the NCR region.

records.name: Tolani Maritime Institute
records.description: Tolani Maritime Institute (TMI) Pune, located in Talegaon, is one of India's premier private maritime training institutes offering BSc (Nautical Science) and BE (Marine Engineering) programs. It is affiliated with Indian Maritime University and recognized by the Directorate General of Shipping, with modern ship simulators and training vessels. TMI has established itself as a leading maritime academy with strong placement outcomes in top international shipping companies.

records.name: Coimbatore Marine College
records.description: Coimbatore Marine College offers maritime training programs including BSc Nautical Science and pre-sea training courses for aspiring merchant navy officers. Located inland in Coimbatore, it provides theoretical and simulator-based training for maritime aspirants from Tamil Nadu and surrounding regions. The college is approved by the Directorate General of Shipping and affiliated with Indian Maritime University.

records.name: Management Development Institute (MDI)
records.description: Management Development Institute (MDI) Gurgaon, established in 1973, is one of India's premier management institutions, known for its PGPM (MBA equivalent) and National Management Programme for senior executives. It is accredited by AMBA (Association of MBAs) and is recognized for excellence in general management, human resources, and public policy. MDI Gurgaon's proximity to major corporations in the NCR region provides outstanding industry interface and placement opportunities.

records.name: Symbiosis Institute of Business Management (SIBM)
records.description: Symbiosis Institute of Business Management (SIBM) Pune is one of India's top-ranked business schools, part of Symbiosis International University, offering MBA programs in general management, innovation and entrepreneurship, and sports management. SIBM Pune is consistently ranked among India's top 10 private business schools and is known for its diverse student body, international exposure, and strong corporate connections. It is AACSB accredited and offers rich extra-curricular opportunities through Symbiosis's multicultural campus.

records.name: MICA
records.description: MICA (formerly Mudra Institute of Communications Ahmedabad) is India's only fully residential communications management school, offering the flagship PGDM-C program combining business management with strategic marketing and communications. It is the premier institution for brand management, marketing communications, and media management in India, with unmatched industry connect and alumni in top advertising, marketing, and digital companies. MICA is consistently ranked India's number one school for marketing and communications.

records.name: Amity School of Fashion Technology
records.description: Amity School of Fashion Technology (ASFT) Noida, part of Amity University, offers BDes and MDes programs in fashion design and technology with modern design labs and industry collaborations. It provides training in fashion designing, garment construction, textile science, and fashion business, with placement support across India's growing fashion industry. ASFT benefits from Amity's extensive industry network and modern campus infrastructure.

records.name: INIFD
records.description: INIFD (Inter National Institute of Fashion Design) is one of India's largest fashion and interior design education networks, with centers across more than 85 cities. It offers diploma and certificate programs in fashion design, interior design, and jewelry design, making design education accessible to students across tier-2 and tier-3 cities. INIFD is known for its practical, industry-oriented curriculum and collaboration with fashion industry professionals.

records.name: IMT Ghaziabad
records.description: IMT Ghaziabad (Institute of Management Technology) is one of India's leading private business schools, established in 1980, offering PGDM, PGDM-Executive, and PhD programs. It is AACSB accredited and consistently ranked among India's top 20 business schools, known for strong programs in finance, marketing, and operations. IMT Ghaziabad has an active international exchange program and strong alumni network across corporate India.

records.name: JD Institute of Fashion Technology
records.description: JD Institute of Fashion Technology Bengaluru is a prominent private fashion design institution with campuses across India, offering diploma and degree programs in fashion design, interior design, and jewelry design. It is known for its industry-relevant curriculum, qualified faculty, and strong placement connections with fashion brands, retail companies, and design studios. JD Institute provides a creative learning environment with access to modern design studios and professional tools.
